group_name: Short video from a picture or text
title: Mixed Sizes Without Cropping

turns.text: These photos are all different shapes. Make one 10-second vertical reel, in this order. Keep each whole photo visible—don't stretch or crop them. Use a soft blurred background to fill the gaps. No music or text.

tests: Checks consistent vertical composition of landscape, square and portrait photos without cropping or distortion.

answer_sheet.Photos and order: All five in attachment order: storefront, latte, pastries, barista, interior.
answer_sheet.Mixed-size handling: Fit each complete photo inside the frame without stretching or cropping. Fill unused space with a soft blurred background.
answer_sheet.Background details and transitions: Your call, as long as the background is softly blurred and each whole foreground photo stays visible.

must_haves: One silent 9:16 reel runs for approximately 10 seconds with no added text.
All five supplied photos appear in the requested order.
The landscape storefront, barista and interior photos retain their complete image boundaries.
The square latte and vertical pastries photos also remain fully visible, without cropping.
Every foreground photo retains its original proportions, with no stretching or squashing.
Unused canvas around fitted photos is filled with a soft blurred background rather than plain bars.
